title: The Performing Piano: Live Legendary Masters Performances - VG
descriptionText: The product is a CD titled "The Performing Piano: Amazing 'Live' Performances By Legendary Masters," featuring various artists and released by Performance in 1986. This album showcases live performances by legendary piano masters in the classical genre, captured on CD in a standard jewel case with multicolor artwork. The inlay condition is excellent, making it a valuable addition to any music collection for fans of classical piano music.
